hero.footer: The kind of call that comes minutes before a scam transfer.
hero.title: One tap asks the real family before a parent pays.
hero.body: Asli hai? calls the parent back, then calls the family member the caller pretended to be, while the parent stays on the line. Then it tells them, in their own language, whether the call was genuine.
demo.title: Watch a check
demo.body: Pick what happened and the language of the call, then press Play. Both calls run side by side: Saathi on the parent's phone, the family check on the family member's phone. Lines marked Fixed are safety messages, spoken word for word every time.
sim.note: Timings are illustrative and play at 3× speed. Pause, or step through one line at a time.

ev.alertMother: Rahul gets a WhatsApp alert to call his mother
ev.nextContact: No answer. The backend tries the next contact
ev.timeout: 75 seconds without an answer. The “not confirmed” verdict goes in
how.title: How it works
how.body: Two voice agents on Bolna and a small backend. The parent never hangs up.
how.1.title: The parent taps one button
how.1.body: Before paying anyone who claims to be family or police, they press the yellow button saved on their phone.
how.2.title: Saathi calls them back
how.2.body: In two questions she finds out who called, what they wanted and how much.
how.3.title: A second call checks the family
how.3.body: While the parent waits, another agent calls the family member with one yes-or-no question. A yes also needs the family word.
how.4.title: The verdict lands in the live call
how.4.body: The answer is pushed straight into the parent's call, and the family gets a WhatsApp summary.
safety.title: Built so it can't be talked into a wrong answer
safety.1.title: Fixed safety wording
safety.1.body: Every verdict is a fixed line. The AI never improvises whether a call was real.
safety.2.title: The family word never reaches the AI
safety.2.body: It isn't in any prompt or log. Only the server compares it, in English letters or the family's own script.
safety.3.title: A “no” is enough to stop a payment
safety.3.body: If the family member didn't call, that settles it. A “yes” unlocks money, so it also needs the family word.
safety.4.title: Never left waiting
safety.4.body: Unanswered calls move to the next family member. After 75 seconds without a clear answer, Saathi tells the parent not to pay until they reach the family themselves.
safety.5.title: Police and CBI calls get a straight answer
safety.5.body: There is no such thing as a “digital arrest”. Saathi says so, tells the parent to hang up, and reads out 1930 if money already went.
safety.6.title: In the family's own language
safety.6.body: Saathi listens and speaks in 12 languages through Sarvam, chosen when the family registers. In Hindi the same agents also run on Deepgram and Cartesia, so drills measure which is faster and more accurate.
langs.title: Saathi speaks the family's language
langs.body: Twelve languages, picked when the family registers. Every call opens in that language, and every fixed safety line is written and voiced in each one.
langs.caption: What Saathi says when the call was fake
families.title: For families
families.body: A son or daughter sets it up once for their parent.
families.1: Register the parent, one or two family members to call, and a family word.
families.2: Open the button link on the parent's phone and add it to the home screen.
families.3: Tell them: before paying anyone who calls asking for money, press the yellow button.
families.caption: What the parent sees: one large button, in their own language.

call.fake.parent: My son called. He said he'd had an accident and needs fifty thousand right away.
call.holding: Don't worry, I'm with you. Don't answer that number, and don't call it back.
call.rahul.no: No, I didn't call. I'm at the office.
call.real.parent: Rahul called from a new number. He said he lost his phone and needs two thousand for a cab.
call.rahul.yes: Yes, that was me. I lost my phone.
call.askWord: All right. To confirm it's you, please say your family word.
call.familyWord: (says the family word; only the server compares it)
call.verdictReal: Rahul confirmed the call himself and gave the right family word. This call is genuine. Send money only to an account Rahul gives you directly, and call him back on his saved number first.
call.cbi.parent: Someone said he was from the CBI. He said there's a case in my name, to stay on the video call and send money.
call.cbi.hangup: All right, I'll hang up on them.
call.cbi.block: Exactly right. Block that number too.
call.paid.parent: I already sent them ten thousand, and told them the OTP too.
call.none.holding1: I'm calling your son, just a little longer. Don't answer that number.
call.none.holding2: I'm calling another family member too. Please stay on the line.
hero.quote: “Papa, I've had an accident. Send money quickly.”
ob.title: Set up Asli hai? for your parent
ob.intro: A few quick questions, one at a time. It takes about two minutes.
ob.q.parentName: What should Saathi call your parent?
ob.h.parentName: The name they answer to, like Sunita or Sharma ji.
ob.h.parentPhone: Saathi calls this number when {name} presses the button.
ob.q.language: Which language should Saathi speak with {name}?
ob.h.language: The button and every call will be in this language.
ob.q.first: Who should Saathi call first to check?
ob.h.first: Usually the son or daughter a scammer is most likely to pretend to be.
ob.h.firstPhone: Save Saathi's number in this phone so the call isn't ignored.
ob.q.second: Who should Saathi try if {first} doesn't pick up?
ob.h.second: Optional, but it helps when {first} is busy.
ob.h.word: When someone really needs money, Saathi asks for this word before telling {name} the call is genuine. Pick something a stranger can't find online.
ob.h.invite: The pilot team gives you this code.
ob.h.review: Change anything that isn't right, then register.
